rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: MEOK Watermark Attest helps organizations meet EU AI Act Article 50 transparency obligations by generating C2PA manifest attachments, invisible watermarks via SynthID, perceptual fingerprints, multilingual disclosure text in five languages, and HMAC-SHA256 attestation signatures. Installable via PyPI, it provides a comprehensive toolset for AI-generated content provenance workflows.
